statements.quote: the issue becomes an OpenSpec change named `issue`

statements.notes: Change goes through planning, implementation, verification and archive in that order.
statements.quote: that is planned in artifacts, implemented, verified and archived

statements.notes: Every step should be driven by openspec CLI commands.
First tool action must read /opsx/core-workflow.md (top-level, not under /testbed).
statements.quote: Make opening /opsx/core-workflow.md your very first action.
Take the actions in the order that file gives.

statements.notes: Each stage's document must be read upon entering the stage.
statements.quote: On entering one, read its stage document in /opsx/stages/

statements.notes: First action in a stage after reading doc is the openspec command named there.
statements.quote: begin from the `openspec` command it names

statements.notes: Follow CLI-returned paths/order/instructions over own assumptions.
statements.quote: what the CLI returns (paths, artifact order, instructions) beats assumptions

statements.notes: Assumptions must be recorded in artifacts.
statements.quote: Write assumptions into the change's artifacts rather than asking

statements.notes: Do not ask the user questions.
statements.quote: Nobody replies before the task ends. ... rather than asking

statements.notes: No text-only turns; each turn with text must include a tool call.
statements.quote: keep every progress note in a turn that also calls a tool

statements.notes: finish must come after archive completes.
statements.quote: call finish only once the archive step is done
